title: Sequence an earlier past event
instructions: Choose the form that preserves the stated past sequence.

parts.prompt: When Maya arrived at 4 p.m., the rehearsal ___. She joined the final scene rather than the opening.

choice_rationales.A: Present perfect does not take the finished past arrival as its reference point.
choice_rationales.B: Simple present would describe a routine and does not mark the rehearsal as earlier than Maya's arrival.
choice_rationales.C: Future form contradicts the completed past sequence.
choice_rationales.D: Had already begun makes the rehearsal's start earlier than Maya's 4 p.m. arrival.

parts.hint: Use Maya's arrival as the past reference point and locate the rehearsal's beginning relative to it.
parts.correct_explanation: The rehearsal began before Maya arrived, so past perfect makes the earlier past event explicit.
